lines.text: You left this on the kitchen table.
My key. I thought I had everything.
lines.ko: 내 열쇠네. 다 챙긴 줄 알았는데.

lines.text: I could post it tomorrow.
Then why did you run all the way here?
I wanted to know you got on the right train.
There is only one train, Maya.
I know. I had a better sentence on the way.
lines.ko: 알아. 오는 길에는 더 괜찮은 말이 생각났었는데.

lines.text: You still have a minute.
Call me when the new place starts to feel like home.
lines.ko: 새집이 네 집처럼 느껴지기 시작하면 전화해.

lines.text: I will. And I am keeping the key.
lines.ko: 그럴게. 그리고 열쇠는 내가 가지고 있을게.

lines.text: The sleeves are a little long.
Fold them once. Nobody will notice.
lines.ko: 한 번 접어. 아무도 모를 거야.

lines.text: There is cash in the pocket.
Old jacket. Things get lost in it.
lines.ko: 오래된 재킷이잖아. 별게 다 들어 있지.

lines.text: Exactly enough for a return ticket?
A very organised jacket.
I said I could manage.
lines.ko: 나 혼자 할 수 있다고 했잖아.

lines.text: And I said you could borrow it. All of it.
lines.ko: 난 빌려도 된다고 했고. 전부 다.

lines.text: I will bring it back tomorrow.
Keep it until they give you the job.

expressions.en: a ticket for going and coming back

expressions.ko: 혼자 해낼 수 있었다 / 여기서는 도움 없이 해내겠다는 말

lines.text: We close in five minutes.
You said that five minutes ago.
I was hoping you had a watch.
My mother used to paint windows like that.
lines.ko: 우리 엄마도 저런 창문을 그리곤 했어요.

lines.text: Is that why you have been standing here?
lines.ko: 그래서 계속 여기 서 계셨던 거예요?

lines.text: Her windows always had someone coming home.
lines.ko: 엄마 그림 속 창문에는 늘 집에 돌아오는 사람이 있었어요.

lines.text: This one is empty.
Maybe they are just late.
I need to turn the lights off in the other room.
Then I have five more minutes.
Play it from the beginning.
I have. Three times.
Why is it quiet?
I checked the camera. I did not check the microphone.
lines.ko: 카메라는 확인했어. 마이크는 확인 안 했고.

lines.text: That was the take.
I know.
We cannot get that light tomorrow.
We have twelve minutes of it left today.
You think we can do it again?
lines.ko: 다시 할 수 있을 것 같아?

lines.text: I think I owe you a reason to try.
lines.ko: 다시 해볼 이유는 내가 만들어줘야 할 것 같아.

expressions.phrase: owe you a reason to try
expressions.ko: 다시 해볼 이유를 마련해줘야 할 책임이 있다
expressions.en: feel responsible for giving someone a reason to try

lines.text: Is this seat taken?
It has been waiting for someone.
I can find another table.
You could also sit down.
I was not sure you would want me here.
lines.ko: 네가 내가 오는 걸 반길지 모르겠더라.

lines.text: I bought the tea you like. It expires on Friday.
That sounds like a deadline.
It is a very small box.
Then we should probably start today.
I will get a second cup.

expressions.en: ask whether a seat is available
seems to set a time limit

lines.text: What is in the last box?
Things nobody wanted to label.
That means you have already looked.
There is a photo of us in the garden.
Keep it.
You say that about everything.
It is easier than saying I want it.
We can make a copy.
A copy will not have the fold in the middle.
Then you keep this one. I remember the fold.
lines.ko: 그럼 이건 네가 가져. 난 그 자국 기억하니까.

lines.text: I cannot remember the first line.
You said it in the lift.
That was before there were people outside.
Then say it to me.
What if nothing comes out?
I will still be standing here.
lines.ko: 난 계속 여기 서 있을 거야.

lines.text: You make it sound very simple.
It is one line. We can worry about the second after that.
lines.ko: 딱 한 줄이야. 두 번째는 그다음에 걱정하자.

lines.text: Will you look at me when I come on?
I was going to ask you the same thing.
lines.ko: 나도 너한테 그 말 하려던 참이야.

lines.text: You are actually here.
I deserve that.
The film started ten minutes ago.
We could catch the next one.
I do not want another next one.
Then tell me what would help.
A message before I leave home. Even a bad one.
lines.ko: 내가 집 나서기 전에 문자 한 통. 안 좋은 소식이어도.

lines.text: I can do that.
And dinner. I skipped dinner for this.
lines.ko: 그리고 저녁. 이것 때문에 저녁도 안 먹었어.

lines.text: There is a place across the road. We can go now.
lines.ko: 길 건너에 식당 있어. 지금 가자.

expressions.en: make it to the next showing

lines.text: Will you open it?
You put your name on the application.
That version of me was very confident.
This version made the same work.
lines.ko: 지금의 너도 그 작품을 만든 사람이야.

lines.text: If it is a no, do not make that face.
Which face?
The one that says you knew it would be.
I do not know. That is why the envelope is interesting.
lines.ko: 난 몰라. 그래서 저 봉투가 궁금한 거고.

lines.text: All right. Open it while I am looking.
Come closer. We can read it together.

expressions.ko: 내가 보고 있는 동안 / 내 앞에서
expressions.en: while I can see what happens

lines.text: You are an hour early.
The bus was unusually helpful.
There is another one every ten minutes.
I thought you might want to go home.
I said I was fine.
You have made the same cup of coffee twice.
The first one went cold.
So did the second. Give me the keys.
The back door sticks when it rains.
lines.ko: 뒷문은 비 오면 잘 안 열려.

lines.text: Show me once. Then go get some sleep.
lines.ko: 한 번만 보여주세요. 그리고 가서 좀 주무세요.

expressions.ko: 비가 오면 뻑뻑해져 잘 안 열린다
expressions.en: gets hard to open in rainy weather
